mutants.name: status_wrong_clock
fails: cland_fstart_in_i: ring start reaches [('ff_CLK', 'u_cland_i/u_ring.g_control_status_copy.u_guard_status/lap_q[0]$_DFFE_PP_'), ('ff_CLK', 'u_cland_i/u_ring.g_control_status_copy.u_status/lap_q[0]$_DFFE_PP_')] (want flop D pins only)

mutants.name: status_untyped
fails: cland_fstart_in_i: ring start reaches non-writer flops ['u_cland_i/u_ring.g_control_status_copy.u_guard_status/lap_q[0]$_DFFE_PP_', 'u_cland_i/u_ring.g_control_status_copy.u_guard_status/lap_q[1]$_DFFE_PP_', 'u_cland_i/u_ring.g_control_status_copy.u_guard_status/lap_q[2]$_DFFE_PP_'] outside one origin instance

mutants.name: origin_wrong_clock
fails: cland_tstart_in: origin sampler flops ['u_cland_origin/s0$_SDFF_PN0_', 'u_cland_origin/sf$_DFF_N_'] on clock(s) ['u_cland_origin/strap_efall', 'u_srl_9/clk'] (want one clock port, not the ring clock)
